item.title: WSL Issues Yellow Alert for Nazaré Challenge, Possible Green Light for Saturday
item.description: The announcement stated that contest officials will be tracking a swell set to peak overnight on Friday, with a possible green light for the event on Saturday.

item.title: Nic Von Rupp: This Weekend’s Nazaré Swell Could Be One of the Best in Years
item.description: Nic von Rupp says Nazaré is looking primed to show the best version of itself in years this weekend with wave faces up to 60 feet groomed by offshore winds.

item.title: Club Med to Open Second North American Ski Resort
item.description: All-inclusive resort company, Club Med recently announced the second part of its North American expansion, to be located in Mont-Tremblant, Quebec.

item.title: Russian, Belarusian Skiers Approved to Compete in Winter Olympics as Neutral Athletes
item.description: The International Ski and Snowboard Federation approved three skiers from Russia and six from Belarus to compete in qualifying events for the games.

item.title: Justine Dupont and Clement Roseyro Win Punta Galea Challenge
item.description: French surfers Justine Dupont and Clement Roseyro drove across the border into Spain and swept the podium at the Punta Galea Challenge.

item.title: Swiss Ski Team Has Third Olympic Champion Injured In One Month
item.description: The Swiss women's Alpine Ski team has been hit by its third injury in just one month. All three of the skiers have been former Olympic champions.

item.title: Killer Whales and Dolphins Filmed Hunting Cooperatively for the First Time
item.description: Killer whales and dolphins have been observed hunting together. They rely on salmon from the waters of British Columbia but they'd never been filmed teaming up.

item.title: This Hawaiian Lifeguard Is Saving Lives in the Water and at the Kitchen Table
item.description: On any given day, Joey Cadiz could lives as a North Shore lifeguard, ride big waves during lunch, or help feed his community through his taro farm.

item.title: Telluride Ski Patrol Union Rejects Resort’s Final Offer, Holiday Strike Likely
item.description: Telluride ski patrollers rejected a final contract offer from the resort owner, making a strike during the upcoming holiday season likely.

item.title: Kitesurfer Shatters World Record by Launching Over 131 Feet
item.description: Hugo Wigglesworth likes to get high, and on December 6, he got higher than anyone else. He broke the world record for the highest kitesurfing jump.
